items.markdown:
**No, exercise does not meaningfully speed up alcohol metabolism** **.** Your liver breaks down alcohol at a largely fixed rate—averaging about one standard drink per hour (or roughly 0.015% blood alcohol concentration per hour)—regardless of physical activity.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF180AyyxTYaMxL2fXxB9_SkkzCDWyu1sM2_SDbdMoJ_cUHc0-LKufmCEaiIDytRFEGOxr0r2yGA90YVZBH1OJa-p2-l-PPve4eXTDDrR3mx3lJARxL2FQiN-6gGH1rax9z-nvhxV4l2lJ3xFEvgUViUb7yo5K_xQYqiOIwpgoI_CpqMQG)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF14H6lgERwDwq-_I5q6AGDHtzAnmgPsFWv3jDiezx9IYeAbAHr6K0jgzfdCjmEcq77Y3WlDHjS-ORtmy719nID65nnpKiLfvoYfD27saTdlzcxjQzt19l08TYj7-IU6fFCub5_z5ppJ9TcDLD7DTYn8oZSHU5IVQyQ0o0M28Bhk5o9AlQF00BMZILOZM1ZKcg8IQmfKXmJNLM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF15-qvyuPZyv9K38yJ4Lk8VR1rOlLDnhdQHGiyCSzsvA8ipKyNfRvUyLkUMUjNiTqDSrYR4ZxIYKSxEwKwhEWwXMqw6Rdgx06tNTEA99iv7AQicvQS_48LZshB83cwo49Plh1V4gKBW1Qbx30ExuLW-stAadPEsEtgDdBg4Q)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF11CvVEwACrj0h6xw4WzOK4H5zB_rnacVxtRahR8jjUtfrMQYbiZeVxsXI0xbZMSdecBfigyWm_mmpPsGF7SzQHoQMH0DPH1TN4RvT8yesX6KWoCT-b-wHF1TCtOqk8m7Qdmfr-JOtjXxckzTq5KqcMqCQEB8rNpYamrDdOatr6jkWpBZw77c22mWHpEP9hgbabL3)

### Why Exercise Doesn't Speed It Up

- **Liver enzymes run at capacity:** Most alcohol is processed by liver enzymes (like alcohol dehydrogenase) at a steady rate that doesn't accelerate just because you move more.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF14H6lgERwDwq-_I5q6AGDHtzAnmgPsFWv3jDiezx9IYeAbAHr6K0jgzfdCjmEcq77Y3WlDHjS-ORtmy719nID65nnpKiLfvoYfD27saTdlzcxjQzt19l08TYj7-IU6fFCub5_z5ppJ9TcDLD7DTYn8oZSHU5IVQyQ0o0M28Bhk5o9AlQF00BMZILOZM1ZKcg8IQmfKXmJNLM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF15-qvyuPZyv9K38yJ4Lk8VR1rOlLDnhdQHGiyCSzsvA8ipKyNfRvUyLkUMUjNiTqDSrYR4ZxIYKSxEwKwhEWwXMqw6Rdgx06tNTEA99iv7AQicvQS_48LZshB83cwo49Plh1V4gKBW1Qbx30ExuLW-stAadPEsEtgDdBg4Q)
- **Sweating removes very little:** Only a small fraction of alcohol (roughly 2% to 10%) leaves the body through sweat, breath, and urine combined. Working up a sweat will not "sweat out" alcohol quickly.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF15-qvyuPZyv9K38yJ4Lk8VR1rOlLDnhdQHGiyCSzsvA8ipKyNfRvUyLkUMUjNiTqDSrYR4ZxIYKSxEwKwhEWwXMqw6Rdgx06tNTEA99iv7AQicvQS_48LZshB83cwo49Plh1V4gKBW1Qbx30ExuLW-stAadPEsEtgDdBg4Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF14H6lgERwDwq-_I5q6AGDHtzAnmgPsFWv3jDiezx9IYeAbAHr6K0jgzfdCjmEcq77Y3WlDHjS-ORtmy719nID65nnpKiLfvoYfD27saTdlzcxjQzt19l08TYj7-IU6fFCub5_z5ppJ9TcDLD7DTYn8oZSHU5IVQyQ0o0M28Bhk5o9AlQF00BMZILOZM1ZKcg8IQmfKXmJNLM)
- **Long-term fitness helps differently:** Regular exercise supports overall liver health and general metabolism over time, though it won't make you sober up faster in the moment.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXRLCzA-QkOsJAZBeifyn-yjQTNuQTkguXXHpbN2BmVkbaTLEIx4x47X9wl9IFL07kCB_y2tYM8pZDBbPDwfenbhFQbBMcw0YLdtuD8lkxr8kiQAERN-YIVsG3kdtcJdp76A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXeQ4h6wY_Llzhmsuh6agsK10muxTNvI4Xs2d9q8NvKm-31yKMtF17muNQr83k-XBx_tojn5k_BBitsYL38W7ei5kuuaVOBzzOSKZx8ruVlhaWQA3-tmjlkdnC8a4P95a0SUKdSCselwPZ)

### Risks of Exercising After Drinking

- **Dehydration:** Alcohol acts as a diuretic, and sweating adds to fluid loss.
- **Impaired coordination and judgment:** Balance, reaction time, and awareness can stay affected even when you feel alert.
- **Reduced stamina and recovery:** Alcohol can lower energy availability, slow muscle recovery, and make fatigue or cramping more likely.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF16gDmTDHKijb8MFfNHUGTDeAHZ4IV5Gvh5hLuuE3-PBptFxV1DfxKuT-FnMKiwYROBFBJVBN7gxnEZwTob-zPhGqsGSBkA8iYjXCHNPxPjIfKvZLNLU2r7k7fDjmdACI3WBy7--4V4Gbftrcb2Kk2-0-v3yiffA5ZYR0kb3qN0egx8u_9KoghXm7jQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESogEBxCJF11qoeE_SV9duaqKrAFOvenfN3W1ckyV52ivp9ifdT8BElXVeIybmVCsL7dJQ32W4x_Q2_PuOMTDmmr6hJlrVgPdjIwca2ADG4XYBvNh1mxaGLD7kn5A45Aitu_tQ8F5AHyC8idRhLJqW0y381ksxYZEfvPaQ0zGDmSMCiV3QsMv_Du9neGWA_XeKn7v2VjWSkBNOgYjFPa_HdA3hKMY)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF14H6lgERwDwq-_I5q6AGDHtzAnmgPsFWv3jDiezx9IYeAbAHr6K0jgzfdCjmEcq77Y3WlDHjS-ORtmy719nID65nnpKiLfvoYfD27saTdlzcxjQzt19l08TYj7-IU6fFCub5_z5ppJ9TcDLD7DTYn8oZSHU5IVQyQ0o0M28Bhk5o9AlQF00BMZILOZM1ZKcg8IQmfKXmJNLM)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXRLCzA-QkOsJAZBeifyn-yjQTNuQTkguXXHpbN2BmVkbaTLEIx4x47X9wl9IFL07kCB_y2tYM8pZDBbPDwfenbhFQbBMcw0YLdtuD8lkxr8kiQAERN-YIVsG3kdtcJdp76A)

For more details on liver processing rates, see [Bowling Green State University](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF11CvVEwACrj0h6xw4WzOK4H5zB_rnacVxtRahR8jjUtfrMQYbiZeVxsXI0xbZMSdecBfigyWm_mmpPsGF7SzQHoQMH0DPH1TN4RvT8yesX6KWoCT-b-wHF1TCtOqk8m7Qdmfr-JOtjXxckzTq5KqcMqCQEB8rNpYamrDdOatr6jkWpBZw77c22mWHpEP9hgbabL3) or physiological research on [PubMed](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXRLCzA-QkOsJAZBeifyn-yjQTNuQTkguXXHpbN2BmVkbaTLEIx4x47X9wl9IFL07kCB_y2tYM8pZDBbPDwfenbhFQbBMcw0YLdtuD8lkxr8kiQAERN-YIVsG3kdtcJdp76A).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF11CvVEwACrj0h6xw4WzOK4H5zB_rnacVxtRahR8jjUtfrMQYbiZeVxsXI0xbZMSdecBfigyWm_mmpPsGF7SzQHoQMH0DPH1TN4RvT8yesX6KWoCT-b-wHF1TCtOqk8m7Qdmfr-JOtjXxckzTq5KqcMqCQEB8rNpYamrDdOatr6jkWpBZw77c22mWHpEP9hgbabL3)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXRLCzA-QkOsJAZBeifyn-yjQTNuQTkguXXHpbN2BmVkbaTLEIx4x47X9wl9IFL07kCB_y2tYM8pZDBbPDwfenbhFQbBMcw0YLdtuD8lkxr8kiQAERN-YIVsG3kdtcJdp76A)Are you asking about **timing a workout** after drinking, **hangover recovery** , or **general alcohol and fitness** ?
